questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Dividing
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'****Connecting****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• **Dividing** means **'to (cause to) separate into parts or groups​' **((कारण) भागों या समूहों में अलग करना) 

 
 
• *Ex: At the end of the lecture, I'd like all the students to **divide** into small discussion groups.*
 
 
 
• Marked option 'Connecting' means **'joining or being joined​'**. (शामिल होना या जुड़ना)
 
 
• *Ex: There's a **connecting** walkway between the buildings.*
 
 
 
• It's clear that 'Dividing' and 'Connecting' are opposite in meaning.

*Therefore, the correct answer is option 3).*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Parting​****:** done while leaving or separating (छोड़ते या अलग करते समय किया गया)
 
• **Breaking****:** to (cause something to) separate suddenly or violently into two or more pieces, or to (cause something to) stop working by being damaged ((कुछ करने के लिए) अचानक या हिंसक रूप से दो या दो से अधिक टुकड़ों में अलग करना, या क्षतिग्रस्त होने से काम करना बंद करना (कुछ करना))
 
• **Detaching​****:** to separate or remove something from something else that it is connected to (किसी अन्य चीज़ से किसी चीज़ को अलग करना या हटाना जिससे वह जुड़ा हुआ है)

options.text: the students to fill the form

questions.solution: The correct answer is **'the students to fill the form**.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The use of the **preposition 'for' before the base form of the verb 'fill'** is **incorrect**. • The **to-infinitive** should be used **in place of** the **preposition 'for'**. • The to-infinitive is used in many sentence constructions, often expressing the purpose of something or someone's opinion about something. • The **to-infinitive** focuses on the idea of an action or the results of an action, rather than the action in itself. • The **to-infinitive** = '**to + base form of the verb (to fill).'** Hence, the correct answer is option 1.​__ Correct sentence: *The teacher asked **the students to fill the form** before entering the classroom*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • Verb** 'fill' **के मूल रूप से पहले preposition **'for' **का प्रयोग गलत है। • Preposition **'for' **के ​​स्थान पर **to-infinitive** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • **To-infinitive** का उपयोग कई वाक्य निर्माणों में किया जाता है, जो अक्सर किसी चीज़ के उद्देश्य या किसी चीज़ के बारे में किसी की राय व्यक्त करते हैं। • **To-infinitive** किसी क्रिया के विचार या किसी क्रिया के परिणामों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है, न कि अपने आप में। • To-infinitive =** 'to + base form of the verb (to fill)'** अतः सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है। **सही वाक्य:** *The teacher asked the students to fill the form before entering the classroom*. 30:T1170, The correct answer is **'****Groan****'**.

questions.question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Soft, inner part of a nut or fruit-stone
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'**Kernel**'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's explore the options:
 
 
• Pulp: a soft, wet mass (एक नरम, गीला द्रव्यमान)
 
• **Kernel****:** the part of a nut that is inside the shell and can be eaten (अखरोट का वह भाग जो खोल के अंदर होता है और खाया जा सकता है)
 
• **Caramel:** burnt sugar used to give flavour and brown colour to food (जली हुई चीनी खाने को स्वाद और भूरा रंग देती है)
 
• **Bean:** a seed, or the pod containing seeds, of various climbing plants, eaten as a vegetable (एक बीज, या फली जिसमें विभिन्न चढ़ाई वाले पौधों का बीज होता है, जिसे सब्जी के रूप में खाया जाता है)
 
 
 
• Thus, from the above meanings correct one-word substitution for the given question is 'Kernel'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**Do not get confused between pulp and kernel

 
• Pulp: the soft, juicy, edible part of a fruit. It is a soft mass of vegetable matter (as of apples) from which most of the water has been extracted by pressure. 
 
• Kernel: the inner softer part of a seed, fruit stone, or nut

Note: In the answer key SSC CGL 2020 Tier-I (17 Aug 2021 Shift 3) The correct answer is Pulp which is incorrect because the meanings of the two options are different. So the correct answer is Option 1 i.e. Kernel. You can check the meaning of the word on Merriam-Webster

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

__No one are supposed to react__ to her prejudiced comments.

options.text: No one has supposed to react
No one is supposed to react
No one had supposed to react

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**No one is supposed to react**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the plural form of the verb 'are' is incorrect.
 
• **No one, nobody, nothing, and nowhere** are **indefinite pronouns**.
 
• We use **no one, nobody, nothing, and nowhere** to refer to an **absence of people, things, or places**.
 
• We use no one, nobody, nothing, and nowhere with a **singular verb**.
 
• Therefore, the singular form of the verb 'is' should be used in place of the plural form 'are'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: ***No one is supposed to react** to her prejudiced comments*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Subjects and verbs must agree with one another in number (singular or plural). (विषय और क्रिया एक दूसरे के साथ संख्या (एकवचन या बहुवचन) में सहमत होना चाहिए)
 
• Thus, if a subject is singular, its verb must also be singular; if the subject is plural, its verb must also be plural. (इस प्रकार, यदि कोई विषय एकवचन है , तो उसकी क्रिया भी एकवचन होनी चाहिए ; यदि विषय बहुवचन है , तो उसकी क्रिया भी बहुवचन होनी चाहिए)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में 'are' क्रिया का बहुवचन रूप गलत है ।
 
• **No one, nobody, nothing** और **nowhere indefinite pronouns** हैं।
 
• हम लोगों, चीजों या स्थानों की अनुपस्थिति को संदर्भित करने के लिए** no one, nobody, nothing** और **nowhere **का उपयोग करते हैं।
 
• हम **एकवचन क्रिया **के साथ no one, nobody, nothing और nowhere का उपयोग करते हैं।
 
• इसलिए बहुवचन क्रिया** 'are' **के स्थान पर एकवचन क्रिया** 'is'** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

सही वाक्य: *No one is supposed to react to her prejudiced comments*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. In some cases, the problem of the lowering of the river bottom has caused the water table of the surrounding area to drop, which has adversely affected agriculture.

B. Also, another problem, canalization with its extensive system of locks and navigation dams, often seriously disrupts riverine ecosystems.

C. The ever-increasing exploitation of rivers has given rise to a variety of problems.

D. Further, extensive commercial navigation of rivers has resulted in much artificial improvement of natural channels, including increasing the depth of the channels to permit passage of larger vessels.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CABD'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'C' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "a variety of problems occurring due to exploitation of rivers". Hence, 'C' is the first part.
 
• Sentence A will come after C because it **introduces** **one of the problems i.e. the lowering of the river bottom has affected agriculture**.
 
• Sentence B will come after A because it explains the next problem i.e. **canalization seriously disrupts riverine ecosystems**.
 
• The sentence 'D' is the concluding part because it **further explains** the advantage of **extensive commercial navigation of rivers**.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *The ever-increasing exploitation of rivers has given rise to a variety of problems. In some cases, the problem of the lowering of the river bottom has caused the water table of the surrounding area to drop, which has adversely affected agriculture. Also, another problem, canalization with its extensive system of locks and navigation dams, often seriously disrupts riverine ecosystems. Further, extensive commercial navigation of rivers has resulted in much artificial improvement of natural channels, including increasing the depth of the channels to permit passage of larger vessels.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य** 'C' **किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "नदियों के शोषण के कारण होने वाली विभिन्न समस्याओं" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः** 'C' **पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य** A**, C के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह कई समस्याओं में से एक का परिचय देता है यानी **नदी के तल के नीचे जाने से कृषि प्रभावित हुई है।**
 
• वाक्य **B**, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह अगली समस्या की व्याख्या करता है यानी **नहरीकरण गंभीर रूप से नदी के पारिस्थितिक तंत्र को बाधित करता है।**
 
• वाक्य** 'D' **समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह आगे **नदियों के व्यापक वाणिज्यिक नेविगेशन के लाभ की व्याख्या करता है।**

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Who wrote the Ramayana?

options.text: By whom was the Ramayana written?
By whom was that who wrote the Ramayana?
Who was that who wrote the Ramayana?
By who was the Ramayana written?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**By whom was the Ramayana written?**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the past simple tense.
 
• In sentences containing** 'who'**, the passive starts with **'by whom'.**The following structure is followed:-
 
 
• Active Voice - Who + V1 + Object?
 
• Passive Voice - By whom + helping verb + Object + V3?
 
 
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Active Voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
 
• Passive Voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य active voice में है और यह past simple tense में है।
 
• 'Who' वाले वाक्यों में, passive voice की शुरुआत** 'by whom'** होती है। निम्नलिखित संरचना का अनुसरण किया जाता है: -
 
 
• Active Voice - Who + V1 + Object?
 
• Passive Voice - By whom + helping verb + Object + V3?
 
 
 
• यह past simple tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।

questions.question:

A news article that reports the recent death of a person
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Obituary****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's explore the options:
 
 
• Obituary: a report, especially in a newspaper, that gives the news of someone's death and details about their life (एक रिपोर्ट, विशेष रूप से एक समाचार पत्र में, जो किसी की मृत्यु की खबर देती है और उनके जीवन के बारे में विवरण देती है)
 
• **Review****:** to think or talk about something again, in order to make changes to it or to make a decision about it (किसी चीज़ के बारे में फिर से सोचना या बात करना, उसमें बदलाव करने या उसके बारे में निर्णय लेने के लिए)
 
• **Mortuary:** a building, or a room in a hospital, etc. where dead bodies are kept before they are sent to be buried or burned, sometimes so that they can be examined (एक इमारत, या एक अस्पताल में एक कमरा, आदि जहां शवों को दफनाने या जलाने के लिए भेजे जाने से पहले रखा जाता है, कभी-कभी उनकी जांच की जा सकती है)
 
• **Editorial:** an article in a newspaper that expresses the editor's opinion on a subject of particular interest at the present time (एक समाचार पत्र में एक लेख जो वर्तमान समय में विशेष रुचि के विषय पर संपादक की राय व्यक्त करता है)
 
 
 
• Thus, from the above meanings correct one-word substitution for the given question is 'Obituary'.

They also accused his twin brother, Bill, of being his (5) accomplice.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य ''*The police charged him ___(4)___ the crime and put him behind bars*.'' **किसी को अपराध करने के लिए जेल में डालने के बारे में** कुछ बता रहा है। • आइए दिए गए विकल्पों का पता लगाएं: • Preposition 'on' का अर्थ है **किसी वस्‍तु के विषय में, किसी वस्‍तु पर**। • Preposition 'in' का अर्थ है **व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की दशा या स्थिति व्‍यक्त करने के लिए प्रयुक्त**। • Preposition 'with' का अर्थ है **किसी बात के कारण; किसी बात के फलस्‍वरूप**। • Preposition 'of' का अर्थ है **किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के स्‍वामित्‍ववाला, से संबंधित या उसका भाग; का**। • Charge (one) with (something) - आधिकारिक तौर पर किसी पर अपराध का आरोप लगाने के लिए। • उदाहरण के लिए -They finally caught Capone by charging him with tax evasion.
